avatar_field.tooltip: Drag your Avatar GameObject or Prefab here
fbx_not_found: Original FBX Not Found. Please reimport it.
fbx_unknown: The FBX version could not be automatically detected. Reason: Unknown or modified FBX file.
fbx_missing: The FBX version could not be automatically detected. Reason: Mesh is missing or not sourced from an FBX file.
source_fbx_ver.tooltip: Please manually select the correct source version.
fbx_unsupported: This FBX file is not supported. Please select a different prefab.
fbx_target.tooltip:
Your avatar is using a non-original FBX file for the mesh. Please select the target used to generate the mesh.
If the vertex order is inconsistent in edited FBX file, issues may occur when adding blendshapes.
current_in_use: FBX Currently in use by the avatar
ft_exist:
It appears that there is already an existing Face Tracking Addon.
 Please ensure that you delete the old addon before adding the new one.
update_mesh.tooltip: The generated mesh is outdated. Click 'Update Mesh' to regenerate it.
memory_cost: Current Avatar Parameter Memory Cost: {0} bits
synced_limit: You have exceeded the limit for synced parameters in VRChat: {0} > 256 bits
ft_make_new: Apply Face Tracking as new Avatar
blueprint_warning: Warning: Blueprint ID Already Exists. Attempting to delete OSC config during upload. If sync issues arise, please reset the OSC config in VRChat or upload your avatar with a new Blueprint ID to ensure proper functionality of VRCFT.
blend_share_error: BlendShare(≥ v1.0.1) is not installed. Please import BlendShare to proceed
qpc.parameters.tooltip: The sync expression parameters memory needed for this quantization parameter
qpc.combined_remote.tooltip: Only combines parameters remotely. Selecting this option can halve the sync parameter requirements.
qpc.combined_local.tooltip: Only combines parameters locally. Selecting this option does not affect sync parameter requirements.
qpc.resolution.tooltip: Adjusts the precision of the sync parameters. Higher resolution provides more precise values remotely but requires more parameter space. Adjusting this does not affect the local precision.
qpc.scale_factor.tooltip: Adjusts the scale of the parameters. Increasing the scale factor can enhance the sensitive of the parameter value, while reducing it can make the value less sensitive.
qpc.installing_layers.tooltip: The VRChat playable layers to install the quantization parameter generator animation.
qpc.enable_layer_selection.tooltip: Enable animation layer selection. If disabled, it will be installed to FX.
eye_tracking_settings.eye_weight.tooltip: The weight of EyeClosed blendshape from face tracking.
eye_tracking_settings.reset.tooltip: The weight of blending expression {0} blendshapes to 0 when eye is closed.
mouth_tracking_settings.jaw_strength.too: The strength of Jaw Drop when mouth is opened.
mouth_tracking_settings.reset_weight.too: The weight of blending expression blendshapes to 0 when mouth is opened.
ue.MouthClosed.tooltip: Closing the mouth while jaw dropping. The value should not be greater than 'JawOpen'.
ue.JawX.tooltip: Move the jaw left or right.
ue.MouthX.tooltip: Move the mouth left or right.
ue.MouthUpperUp.tooltip: Raise the upper part of the lip.
ue.MouthUpperUpLeft.tooltip: Raise the upper left part of the lip.
ue.MouthUpperUpRight.tooltip: Raise the upper right part of the lip.
ue.MouthLowerDown.tooltip: Lower the lower part of the lip.
ue.MouthLowerDownLeft.tooltip: Lower the lower left part of the lip.
ue.MouthLowerDownRight.tooltip: Lower the lower right part of the lip.
ue.MouthStretch.tooltip: Stretch the mouth horizontally, often appearing with a frown. (Supported on Quest and Pico; not supported on Vive.)
ue.MouthStretchLeft.tooltip: Stretch the left side of the mouth, often appearing with a frown. (Supported on Quest and Pico; not supported on Vive.)
ue.MouthStretchRight.tooltip: Stretch the right side of the mouth, often appearing with a frown. (Supported on Quest and Pico; not supported on Vive.)
ue.MouthDimple.tooltip: Create dimples on the sides of the mouth, often appearing with a smile. (Supported on Quest and Pico; not supported on Vive.)
ue.MouthDimpleLeft.tooltip: Create a dimple on the left side of the mouth, often appearing with a smile. (Supported on Quest and Pico; not supported on Vive.)
ue.MouthDimpleRight.tooltip: Create a dimple on the right side of the mouth, often appearing with a smile. (Supported on Quest and Pico; not supported on Vive.)
ue.MouthRaiserUpper.tooltip: Raise the upper part of the mouth.
ue.MouthRaiserLower.tooltip: Raise the lower part of the mouth.
ue.LipFunnel.tooltip: Create a small 'O' shape with the lips.
ue.SmileFrown.tooltip: Create a smile or frown expression.
ue.SmileFrownLeft.tooltip: Smile or frown on the left side.
ue.SmileFrownRight.tooltip: Smile or frown on the right side.
ue.CheekPuffSuck.tooltip: Puff or suck in the cheeks.
ue.CheekPuffSuckLeft.tooltip: Puff or suck in the left cheek.
ue.CheekPuffSuckRight.tooltip: Puff or suck in the right cheek.
ue.TongueX.tooltip: Move the tongue left or right. (Supported on Vive; not supported on Quest and Pico.)
ue.TongueY.tooltip: Move the tongue up or down. (Supported on Vive; not supported on Quest and Pico.)
ue.TongueRoll.tooltip: Roll the tongue. (Supported on Vive; not supported on Quest and Pico.)
ue.NoseSneer.tooltip: Sneer the nose. (Supported on Quest and Pico; not supported on Vive.)
ue.NoseSneerLeft.tooltip: Sneer the left side of the nose. (Supported on Quest and Pico; not supported on Vive.)
ue.NoseSneerRight.tooltip: Sneer the right side of the nose. (Supported on Quest and Pico; not supported on Vive.)
ue.EyeLeftX.tooltip: Left eye look left and right
ue.EyeRightX.tooltip: Right eye look left and right
ue.EyeLeftY.tooltip: Left eye look up and down
ue.EyeRightY.tooltip: Right eye look up and down
ue.PupilDilation.tooltip: Dilate or constrict the pupils. (Supported on Vive; not supported on Quest and Pico.)
ue.BrowExpression.tooltip: Raises or lowers the eyebrow. (Supported on Quest and Pico; not supported on Vive.)
ue.BrowExpressionLeft.tooltip: Raises or lowers the left eyebrow. (Supported on Quest and Pico; not supported on Vive.)
ue.BrowExpressionRight.tooltip: Raises or lowers the right eyebrow. (Supported on Quest and Pico; not supported on Vive.)
